column1: Belt and Road|2018|0|10||7,9,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8|Bruno Maçães|Connects infrastructure, trade routes, financing and geopolitical influence. Strategic possibilities are distinguished from completed results; forecasts lower confidence but do not imply a hype veto.

Editing Humanity|2020|0|0||8,8,7,8,8,8,8,8,8,8|Kevin Davies|Connects CRISPR discovery, experimental capability, institutions and ethical constraints. Scientific development is central; medical applications do not make disease the dominant topic.

Cognitive Gadgets: The Cultural Evolution of Thinking|2018|0|0||8,8,8,8,8,9,5,9,7,8|Cecilia Heyes|Tests cultural-learning accounts of cognitive capacities against evolutionary explanations. Distinctions between inherited capacities and learned tools transfer to models of institutions and learning; broad claims remain contested.

Land of Promise: An Economic History of the United States|2012|10|0||7,9,8,8,8,9,7,7,8,7|Michael Lind|Links technological eras, political institutions and economic organization. The national framework triggers T11; industrial development rather than partisan recruitment is the explanatory center.

The Relentless Revolution: A History of Capitalism|2010|0|0||8,8,7,7,8,9,6,9,8,8|Joyce Appleby|Farming, trade, technology and changing social expectations explain capitalism as historical development. Comparative cases add educational value; cultural interpretation is not a controlled causal test.

The Noblest Triumph: Property & Prosperity Through the Ages|1998|0|0||6,7,7,6,7,8,6,6,8,7|Tom Bethell|Property rights link incentives, investment and prosperity across cases. A strong favored explanation risks understating complementary institutions; inspected evidence does not establish a serious ideological veto.

Crabgrass Frontier|1985|10|0|1980|9,8,6,8,8,9,4,9,8,8|Kenneth T. Jackson|Housing finance, transport, land use and public policy explain American suburbanization. Distinct institutional mechanisms offer transfer despite the urban-history deduction.

Albion's Seed|1989|10|0|1775|8,8,6,7,8,9,3,9,8,8|David Hackett Fischer|Compares migration streams and persistent regional cultural practices. Rich comparisons justify substantial length; continuity claims need care and the American historical focus incurs T11.

Strangers in the Land: Patterns of American Nativism 1860-1925|1955|10|10|1925|9,7,5,6,8,9,3,9,8,8|John Higham|Connects immigration, economic strain and political mobilization. Comparative episodes support historical learning, with limited technical relevance and both national/minority and political thematic deductions.

Human Transit|2011|0|0||8,9,9,9,8,9,8,9,9,8|Jarrett Walker|Frequency, coverage, geometry, transfers and limited resources explain transit tradeoffs. Conceptual explanation supports decision-making without a technical engineering course; logistics rather than urban history is central.

Rethinking America's Highways|2018|10|0||8,9,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8|Robert W. Poole Jr.|Connects road pricing, capital, governance and infrastructure maintenance. Transferable financing constraints are useful, but proposals and institutional assumptions require testing; US policy scope triggers T11.

The Shareholder Value Myth|2012|0|10||8,8,8,7,8,9,6,9,8,8|Lynn Stout|Corporate law and incentives challenge a narrow account of shareholder primacy. Distinguishes legal obligation from managerial choice; institutional power is central, without establishing partisan mobilization.

We the Corporations|2018|10|10|2010|9,8,6,7,8,9,5,9,8,8|Adam Winkler|Legal cases explain how corporations acquired constitutional protections. Court-by-court development adds distinct constraints but concentrates on American institutional power and rights.

Addiction by Design|2012|0|0||9,9,8,9,8,9,7,9,8,8|Natasha Dow Schüll|Ethnography connects interface design, reinforcement, business incentives and user behavior in machine gambling. Design mechanisms transfer beyond casinos; clinical illness is not the organizing center.

Electronic Value Exchange|2011|0|0|1984|9,9,9,9,8,9,9,8,8,9|David L. Stearns|Explains Visa's computing network through standardization, organizational negotiation, reliability and scale. A history of technical and institutional decisions, not a payment-programming reference. Endpoint 1984 is an approximate scope judgment. https://www.overdrive.com/media/3494427/electronic-value-exchange

Faster, Better, Cheaper|2016|0|0||8,9,9,9,8,9,10,9,8,8|Christoph Roser|Manufacturing history connects materials, energy, mechanization, organization and productivity. Distinct production systems provide comparative constraints; historical explanation is the main purpose rather than operator training. https://www.allaboutlean.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/Collected-Blog-Posts-of-AllAboutLean.com-2015-PDF.pdf

Becoming Trader Joe|2021|0|0|1989|7,8,8,8,8,8,6,9,8,7|Joe Coulombe|Explains retail positioning through assortment, purchasing, wages and customer selection. Operational details provide reuse, while the founder's retrospective account limits independent verification.

The Green and the Black|2016|0|0||7,9,8,8,8,8,9,8,8,8|Gary Sernovitz|Connects shale extraction, costs, capital and industry organization. Technical and commercial mechanisms are central; environmental issues are an application rather than the dominant theme. Insider experience requires scrutiny of favorable framing.

American Icon|2012|0|0|2011|8,8,9,8,8,9,8,8,9,8|Bryce G. Hoffman|Ford's recovery links product choices, financing, transparent reporting and organizational coordination. Concrete management constraints provide transfer; a successful turnaround does not prove every credited practice caused success.

Overhaul|2010|10|10|2009|7,9,8,8,8,8,7,9,8,7|Steven Rattner|An insider account of the US auto rescue links capital structure, industrial capability and political bargaining. Access is valuable but self-justification needs caution; US intervention and political-financial decisions are central.

The Meat Racket|2014|10|0||8,9,8,8,8,9,6,8,9,8|Christopher Leonard|Explains concentrated meat production through contracts, market power, risk allocation and supply-chain control. Strong mechanism transfer survives a primarily American agricultural-industry scope.

Crisis in Bethlehem|1986|0|0|1985|8,8,8,8,8,9,9,8,8,8|John Strohmeyer|Steel-industry decline links production choices, investment, labor relations and managerial incentives. Industry failure offers reusable lessons; the US setting alone does not make the book a national history.

Devils on the Deep Blue Sea|2005|0|0|2004|8,8,7,7,8,8,7,8,9,8|Kristoffer Garin|Cruise-industry development links ship economics, regulation, corporate structure and market creation. Distinct business constraints add learning beyond personalities; historical endpoint is approximate.

The Big Score|1998|0|0|1996|8,8,7,7,8,9,7,8,9,8|Jacquie McNish|Voisey's Bay links mineral discovery, bargaining, finance and corporate strategy. Resource development is central, with a concrete case of information advantage and valuation under uncertainty; not Michael Malone's Silicon Valley book.

Excuse Me Sir, Would You Like to Buy a Kilo of Isopropyl Bromide|1977|0|0|1977|7,8,8,8,8,9,9,9,8,7|Max Gergel|Chemical entrepreneurship connects experiments, plant constraints, customers and improvised production. Firsthand technical anecdotes provide transferable lessons, with memoir selection and older practices limiting evidential confidence.

Bacardi and the Long Fight for Cuba|2008|10|10|2007|8,8,6,7,8,9,5,8,9,8|Tom Gjelten|A family enterprise connects production, branding, exile and national political conflict. Company mechanisms remain useful, but Cuban identity and political history dominate much of the narrative.

Blood: An Epic History of Medicine and Commerce|1998|10|0||8,9,8,8,8,9,6,8,9,8|Douglas Starr|Storage, processing, trade, regulation and contamination risks explain blood as a global commodity. Supply-chain and reliability mechanisms transfer; medicine and disease risks trigger T11.

Aerodynamic|2018|0|0||8,10,9,9,9,9,10,9,8,9|Kevin Michaels|Explains the jetliner ecosystem through suppliers, production capacity, maintenance economics and industrial bargaining. Strong integration and practical constraints fit the requested profile; catalog and professional-author evidence support a low-confidence whole-book density estimate. https://www.foyles.co.uk/book/aerodynamic/kevin-michaels/9781624104022

Never Lost Again|2018|0|0|2016|7,9,8,8,8,8,9,9,9,8|Bill Kilday|Keyhole and digital mapping connect geospatial data, computing infrastructure, product design and commercial scale. Insider access reveals decisions, while company-centered storytelling limits critical distance.

The Political Spectrum|2017|10|0||8,9,9,8,8,9,9,9,8,8|Thomas Winslow Hazlett|Spectrum allocation links engineering, incumbency, regulation and innovation. Wireless technology is the explanatory center; US regulation triggers T11. The market-oriented argument needs counterevidence but is not automatically ideological capture. https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300221107/the-political-spectrum/
